name: rh-core
description: Curated RH bibliography seed pack with offline-capable local sources plus the existing OAE Riemann reports.

bibliography.title: Prime number theorem via zero-free regions
bibliography.note: Classical zero-free-region work shows the baseline analytic control but does not prove RH.

bibliography.title: Infinitely many zeros on the critical line
bibliography.note: Critical-line existence result; useful for separating partial on-line results from full RH.

bibliography.title: Explicit formula and prime-zero duality
bibliography.note: Any candidate proof should preserve the explicit formula bridge between zeros and prime powers.

bibliography.title: Pair correlation and GUE heuristics
bibliography.note: Strong statistical evidence for spectral structure, but not a proof.

bibliography.title: Hilbert-Polya operator program
bibliography.note: Search for a self-adjoint operator whose spectrum matches the non-trivial zeros.

bibliography.title: Mollifier and moment methods
bibliography.note: Partial-density-on-the-line results that sharpen evidence without closing RH.

bibliography.title: de Branges / Hilbert space approaches
bibliography.note: Function-space program aimed at forcing zero locations via positivity structure.

bibliography.title: Xi-function and entire-function structure
bibliography.note: Tracks the completed xi-function and Laguerre-Polya style constraints.

bibliography.title: OAE projection, strip, and explicit-formula synthesis
bibliography.note: Geomath lane: projection geometry, strip symmetry, and explicit prime-zero reconstructions.

bibliography.title: Quantum-inspired spectral surrogates
bibliography.note: Simulator-backed operator heuristics; only useful when converted into falsifiable claims.
